text:
maria: Heads up — planning to swap the quant-kernel bundle from v3.2 -> v3.3 in the night window at 00:15 UTC. Deploybot will perform the swap. I'm going to hold thermal-slice buckets 2 and 5 for 30m during the initial ramp.

lee: ack. who is owning the smoke checklist?

maria: priya will run smoke and perf traces. nate will watch infra telemetry. sam, can you update the release note blurb?

sam: yep, I'll draft a short blurb and push to the release-notes repo now. will tag @docs for final copy.

priya: smoke plan: run 3x small-seq gen, 10x chat shard, and one KV-warmstart. pass criteria: p95 latency not > baseline +20%, error rate < 0.5%, no cache-thrash logs. I have a quick script:
```bash
# smoke run
curl -s -X POST https://staging-infer/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"quant-kernel:3.3","input":"smoke test"}' | jq .
```
I'll post the results in 00:05 UTC.

nate: adding infra thresholds: GPU temp < 78C, OoM events = 0, KV eviction ratio < 0.5%. If any infra alarm fires, we pin and roll back.

lee: rollback criteria we agreed last week still apply? specifically:
- p95 latency jump >20% sustained for 5m
- client error rate >1% for 5m
- GPU temp >80C or any OoM
If hit, immediate rollback and pin previous bundle until postmortem.

maria: yes. also add: if model-quality regression on eval suite (top-5 prompts) > 2% we rollback. We'll run a minimal eval at T+10m.

deploybot: @channel Deploybot: scheduled swap queued. Command to pin prior version:
`/deploy pin engine=quant-kernel:3.2 ttl=4h reason="rollback-safety-night"`
Command to abort swap:
`/deploy abort <swap-id>`

ops-bot: NOTE: quiet window in region-eu tonight 23:45-01:30 UTC. Keep ops pager on for that window.

sam: draft pushed: https://git.internal/release-notes/engine/2024-04. Please review. Short summary + known-compat caveats for pinned drivers.

docs: I'll review and add the 'how to pin/unpin' snippet and the troubleshooting matrix. ETA 00:10 UTC.

priya: smoke results: all small-seq passes, p95 +8%, error rate 0.12%, KV eviction 0.1%. GPU temps stable ~74C. posting logs: 
```
smoke-2024-04-19T00:06:12Z p95: 182ms
smoke-2024-04-19T00:06:42Z errors: 0.12%
```

maria: looks good. I'm going to start the swap in 2m. Will annotate release notes with the bake window and pin TTL.

lee: please tag me if anything goes sideways. I'll stand by.

(prior to the swap) deploybot: swap started: swap-id=sb-20240419-01

~6 minutes later~

priya: post-swap quick checks: p95 +12%, errors 0.3%, KV eviction 0.14%. No OoM. Traces show the usual matmul kernel path.

nate: infra graphs look normal. slight increase in mem pressure on a small subset (node-ax-07), keeping it in rollout hold.

maria: holding buckets 2 and 5 as planned. opening a tiny slice for 5% traffic while we confirm stability.

lee: agree on tiny slice. if node-ax-07 continues to climb, we pin that node's bundle back to 3.2 and exclude it from next wave.

ops-bot: Alert: node-ax-07 mem-pressure > threshold at 00:33 UTC.

maria: thanks, pinning node-ax-07 now and excluding from routing.

deploybot: `/deploy pin engine=quant-kernel:3.2 ttl=12h reason="node-ax-07 mem-pressure" target=node-ax-07`

sam: updated release note with addendum about node-level exclusions and the pin command. Pushed change.

docs: published release note draft to the site and added troubleshooting steps for mem-pressure during quant kernel swaps.

maria: OK, action items:
- priya: continue T+10m eval and post results
- nate: keep watching node-level graphs and telemetry, escalate if OoM
- sam/docs: finalize release blurb tomorrow AM with postmortem link if any
- lee: be ready to roll back globally if we hit latency or quality triggers

Everyone: :thumbsup:

~20 minutes later~

priya: T+10m eval done. small regression on one prompt (1.6%) but below rollback threshold. KV eviction stable. No additional infra alarms.

maria: marking the rollout as healthy for night window. I'll remove the 30m hold at 00:50 UTC and let the rest of the buckets roll.

deploybot: swap complete. swap-id=sb-20240419-01 status=healthy.

lee: great job team. I'll draft a short post-deploy checklist for next time to capture the node exclusion step.

maria: thanks all. leaving the pin on node-ax-07 for 12h, then auto-unpin per TTL if stable. Closing thread.
